keySentence: The map promised adventure but also danger.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Jim showed the map to others. They wanted to find the treasure. They got a ship ready. The map promised adventure but also danger.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Jim took the treasure map to Doctor Livesey and Squire Trelawney. They were amazed by what they saw on the map. The squire decided to buy a ship and find the treasure. Jim felt excited but also a little scared. The map promised adventure but also danger. The adventure was about to begin!
facts.Page story text 3 (draft, teacher check: After finding the map, Jim showed it to Doctor Livesey and Squire Trelawney. Both men were thrilled by the possibility of finding buried treasure. The squire immediately decided to buy a ship called the Hispaniola. Jim could hardly believe he would sail across the ocean! The map promised adventure but also danger. However, not everyone on the journey would have good intentions. Because the squire talked too much about the treasure, dangerous people heard about their plan. Jim did not know that trouble was already waiting for them at sea.
facts.Word cards: promised = 약속했다 / but also = 하지만 또한 / adventure = 모험 / buried = 묻혀 있는
